name: notbitlee
description: Open-source, white-label link shortener with click analytics and QR codes. One-click deploy to your own Cloudflare account.
author: Zima Media (https://zimamedia.com)

scripts.deploy: npm run build && npm run db:migrate:remote && wrangler deploy

ADMIN_EMAIL.description: The email address you will **sign in with**. You become the owner of this dashboard.

ADMIN_PASSWORD.description: Your sign-in password. Use **at least 10 characters**; a password manager can make one for you.

BRAND_NAME.description: The name shown on your dashboard. You can change it, your logo and your colour later in **Settings**.

SHORT_DOMAIN.description: Optional. The domain your short links use, e.g. `go.example.com`. Leave empty to start on your free `workers.dev` address.

DASHBOARD_DOMAIN.description: Optional. A separate domain for the dashboard, e.g. `links.example.com`. Leave empty to keep it at `/admin`.

ALLOWED_EMAIL_DOMAIN.description: Optional. Only used with Google sign-in: lets everyone at this Google Workspace domain sign in.

TIMEZONE.description: Time zone for daily click charts, e.g. `Europe/Madrid` or `America/New_York`.

DB.description: Holds your links, clicks, team and settings. Created for you.
